observation_summary: The MathUtils.gcd function returns an incorrect result when the product of the two input arguments overflows to zero.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the implementation of MathUtils.gcd uses the expression 'u * v == 0' to check if either input is zero. When both 'u' and 'v' are large integers containing high powers of 2, their product can overflow and result in zero, causing the function to incorrectly trigger the zero-handling branch even when neither input is actually zero. This leads to an incorrect GCD calculation.
